Results.ReviewText: Recommended to BBQ lovers. Actually, I owe both types of bbq grills and have always preferred the traditional charcoal grill; the taste of wood is unsurpassed by any other method of grilling.
Results.Title: The Best BBQ Experience.

Results.ReviewText: The grill functions very well I especially like the ash collector under the grill. However the legs seem to be cheaper and slightly fragile as compared to my older Weber.
Results.Title: Satisfied, grill owner

Photos.Caption: The Weber in all of its glory.

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill manufactured with pride and superb craftsmanship.
Results.Title: Man’s essential backyard cooker for the carnivores
Not an original, I bought my Original 43 years ago

Results.ReviewText: Overall sturdy and a functional grill. The ash dispenser is a nice feature and when cooking, the grill heats up quickly. However, because of its shape, if you plan to use a blower or a strong fan to get the charcoal going, the ashes blow up and around making quite a mess. If you already have food on the grill, it will blow back on it. Also, the lid hook is quite shallow and the temperature probe not accurate, underestimating the temperature.
Results.Title: A good grill with some limitations

Results.ReviewText: Can't beat the old school weber.  Simple, easy to use and consistantly results in great grilled food.  A must have.
Results.Title: Tried and True

Results.ReviewText: This is the best of old-school grilling. If you’re Gen-X, this is how you recreate the backyard barbecue of your youth.
Results.Title: Backyard barbecue, done right!

Results.ReviewText: I think people got caught up in the egg, Kamado, and barrel smoker trend in recent years and totally forgot about the good ‘ol kettle grill/smoker. Even the Weber gas grills seemed to have gotten more love at one point, but there seems to be a renewed interest in “vintage” things. I guess that happens every few years, and the Weber kettle is a fan favorite once again. So much so, that there are tons of imitators out on the market as well.
Results.Title: Old school classic

Results.ReviewText: Great features like the large ash catcher and the hinged sections of the grill grate for accessing charcoal beds without removing entire grill grate.
Results.Title: Great upgrade from my first Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: This is our second grill of this type and brand.  Great charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: Had my first kettle grill for 21 years and finally bought my second one, there’s none better.
Results.Title: Old Faithful

Results.ReviewText: Weber kettle was my first grill and it will be my last. I’ve been using the kettle grill for about 2 years now and I have to say, I couldn’t be happier. I cook with charcoal often and this is always my go to grill for just that. Great build quality, very easy to assemble, clean and relocate. Easy and simple to use makes a for a impeccable grill. 10 year warranty is remarkable. Price tag might be a little steep but when you consider what you are getting, it is 100000% worth it. Only sticking to weber kettle!
Results.Title: Best kettle grill out there

Results.ReviewText: The design is unparalleled.  The materials , however, just keep,getting cheaper and cheaper
Results.Title: Still the best design, but poor materials

Results.ReviewText: The grill not only meets but exceeds expectations.
Results.Title: Cooking with Class!

Results.ReviewText: works great don't like the burnt charcoal container on bottom difficult to reattach after emptying
Results.Title: review

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill it is easy to use and grill .It is easy to clean .
Results.Title: Weber Original

Results.ReviewText: This is a new grill they cook like all the rest of the grills
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: Had this thing a month now and all the others I’ve used have paled in comparison.
Results.Title: The gold standard for charcoal grills!

Results.ReviewText: I have 3 Weber Kettles. I use them to do everything. From smoking,  grilling to rotisserie.
Results.Title: Great grills.

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber Charcoal Grills, these grills have been the best for all my grilling, wood smoking… etc.
Results.Title: Best Weber Griller

Results.ReviewText: This grill can master anything and has stood the test of time
Results.Title: The Timeless, do-it-all Grill!

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill (copper) on Amazon, and was quite disappointed with the quality once i got it assembled.  The grate hangers located inside of the bowl were not welded on properly (both my grates were wobbly), I had a significant amount of smoke leakage when the lid was on because the bowl itself was out of round and some of the enamel was chipped along the vent openings.   
The customer service rep from Weber got in touch with me and took care of everything!  Thanks to the awesome 10yr warranty the rep was able to get me replacement pieces to fix the issue.  
Weber really stands behind its products and values customer satisfaction.  Will definitely buy their products again!
Results.Title: Good product, amazing customer support

Results.ReviewText: Over the years of grilling I have always tried to achieve the classic grilled taste of a charcoal grill. The problem is every new kind of grill I try I just cannot get the classic grilled taste. So I wind up going back to the Weber which always produces that classic grilled taste, there is nothing like it. No matter how many other grills I have, the Weber Kettle is always in the line up. I bought this new kettle with the ash can below, from the first cook it was great. That taste cannot be duplicated on any other grill, I dare anyone to try.
Results.Title: Classic Charcoal Taste

Results.ReviewText: Third Weber 22” I’ve owned.  Excellent product. Extremely high quality.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic little BBQ that's real easy to clean out the ashes. Easy to control the temperature, lightweight, can be wheeled around anywhere in the backyard. My barrel grill was complicated and never could get the right temp, with this BBQ from my first BBQ never had any issues. Love it!
Results.Title: Small and amazing

Results.ReviewText: The old one rusted out at the vents on the bottom.  They changed the say the top hangs on the kettle, which took some time getting used to.  Works as expected.  This time I bought a cover to prevent rusting.
Results.Title: Replaced the old one

Results.ReviewText: I don’t know but sometimes my grill heats unevenly.  Otherwise it’s a great grill.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Difficult to control high temps when covered and once the charcoal is fully lit.
Results.Title: Grill overheats

Results.ReviewText: could be about 1-2 FT higher but other than that it's good
Results.Title: Not Bad (so far so good)

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely a fantastic barbecue I think I like a charcoal grill better than anything
Results.Title: Great barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Overall great experience, except for one: my lid seems to have a difficult time aligning with the bottom grill. I almost always worried whether the lid would slide down when I walked away. Not sure it's only mine having this issue or it's a room for the design/manufacturing improvement.
Results.Title: Overall good product

Results.ReviewText: Awesome Grill - Would Highly Recommend.  Weber is definitely the best Charcoal Grill.
Results.Title: Smokin

Results.ReviewText:
Great basic bbq for home with no fuss. Easy to instal. Lights really easy, good thermometer system, closes tight. Sturdy. Good size.
Ok ash collecting system (although it could be improved if blades rotated more. 
Too bas that both the vent on the top as well as the ventilation handles below heat up - be careful, you'll get burned!
Results.Title: Good, not great. Be extra careful when using.

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to use, constructed well, easy to clean and makes great food! I love the removable ash can!
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. I can grill or offset cook with it. Thermometer is good when smoking with it.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber kettle! After over 10 years with my previous one, I decided to explore other BBQ options like pellet and ceramic grills, but nothing compares to the original Weber. It's easy to use, offers the best taste, and provides the best value. Highly recommend it!
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: After running a pellet grill for years, I missed the results of charcoal grilling over direct heat. I’ve had a WSM for many years, so decided to buy a classic Weber grill to match. There’s definitely a learning curve with charcoal, but that’s half the fun. Steaks, dogs, and chickens I’ve cooked on it so far have been amazing.
Results.Title: Classic quality and results

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
